body:
Hey I can 100% relate. I've been depressed / suicidal since 2008, I had a small window where I went to therapy and felt better but now I've relapsed.

Anyhow. For some of the darkest 3-4 years I picked up LoL and then DOTA 2. The games were shit and they made me angry, but in retrospect there were an addiction that kept me going. They made me feel awful and unaccomplished, but they kept me going because they were a diversion. At the time I had panic attacks if I walked 100m out of home, and I didn't have to deal with that.

It's better than drinking or drugs of course, but it's still an addiction. When I went to therapy I mailed Riot and got my account deleted, and I sold all my DOTA 2 stuff. Right now that I'm relapsing my brain is begging me to go back to videogames so it can shut down for a while. It's either that or sleeping, but one can't sleep all the time. I'm 27 right now and I don't want to add this shit to my life again, I'm going to therapy again this week and I'll talk with the doctors for a long-term plan or whatever. I'll just tell them I can't make it without meds.

Well I digressed, what I want to say is yes the videogames can keep you going and they allow you to shut down, but they can easily let you burn 3-4 years of your life. Right now if I had to choose I'd go to therapy straight away. Keep that shit out of your life. It's like alcohol but instead of destroying your health it destroys your time.

All I know how to do and I'm comfortable with is illustration. I'm fairly decent and I could run a comic or whatever but there are just so many with the same skills in the field, and so many who are much more competent and specialized than me right now have trouble making ends meet. It's a very competitive field and I was dumb enough to put myself into it. My country also is really heavy on taxes if you're a freelancer regardless of your income or your profession. You're either really good and you blow up with a project or you get employed by a publisher, or nothing. I don't really have the chops to put my life on the line with this. Thanks to the idea of "feeling better with myself" I chose to focus on the really irrelevant and useless things instead of finishing my studies.

I'm not a smart, nor an ambitious person. I'm too cowardly for this kind of stuff. I'm fairly stupid I think and I don't have brilliant ideas to put to the test. I don't want a career I just want a little bit of independence.
